summary: Crash when modifying age property of a pitcher crop
description: The game crashes if the age property of a pitcher crop s top half is set too high. This can be done with a debug stick by a creative user. Steps to reproduce 1. Place farmland 2. Place a pitcher pod on the farmland 3. Fertilize the pitcher crop with bonemeal until it is two blocks high 4. Select the age property with the debug stick 5. Increment the age until the game crashes
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
2. Place farmland on the ground.
3. Place a pitcher pod on the farmland.
4. Use bonemeal to fertilize the pitcher crop until it grows two blocks high.
5. Select the age property of the top half of the pitcher crop using a debug stick.
6. Increment the age value with the debug stick.
7. Continue incrementing the age value until the game crashes.
8. Take a screenshot or record the crash to document the issue.
Observed Behavior: The game crashes when the age property of a pitcher crop's top half is set too high using a debug stick by a creative user. To reproduce this issue, first place farmland and then plant a pitcher pod on it. Use bonemeal to fertilize the pitcher crop until it reaches two blocks in height. Next, use the debug stick to select the age property of the crop and increment its value until the game crashes. This behavior indicates that setting an excessively high age value for the top half of the pitcher crop causes a critical error within the game's code, leading to a complete crash.
Expected Behavior: When modifying the age property of a pitcher crop using a debug stick in Creative mode, the game should not crash. Instead, incrementing the age value should simply change the visual state or maturity level of the pitcher crop without causing any instability or crashes. The game should remain stable regardless of how high the age value is set.
